text: I tried to download a new ebook through my library app last night, only to be met with a spinning wheel and a cryptic error message. It felt like a digital blackout, leaving me staring at a blank screen instead of my new story. After a quick restart and clearing the app cache, everything snapped back into place. It was a frustrating ten minutes, but the seamless recovery reminded me how much I rely on these digital gateways to my favorite books.
